services.desc: 8 Hours • Includes 2 Dives, Gear Rental, and eLearning

includes: This trip includes 2 tanks (aluminum 80s or 63s), weights, lunch and a lot of fun.
Reminders: Includes snacks, water and soda.
Lights not included; we have lights available for purchase.
We provide all the necessary Avelo equipment, including a Hydrotnk, jetpack, regulator, dive computer, and weights.
What's Included: Package includes a mask, snorkel, fins, wetsuit, BCD, regulator, hood and gloves (with dive computer).
All scuba gear provided for classes
Instruction and dive time included in guided dives
Mask, snorkel, fins, and wetsuit included for snorkeling

blurb: Guests can take scuba diving classes from beginner to professional levels, guided scuba dives including Discover Scuba for non-certified divers, and guided snorkeling tours in protected marine preserves. Classes include ocean experience in Catalina's clear waters with all gear provided. Professional dive training includes Divemaster and instructor courses with mentorship and real dive operation experience.
